content.short: Taho Wallet provides Open Source tooling for the ecosystem, is community owned over centralized ownership, emphasizes radical transparency, and aims to improve wallet UX and Web3 onboarding.
content.description: Taho Wallet (Formerly Tally Ho) provides Open Source tooling for the Web3 ecosystem and is community owned. The project emphasizes radical transparency and is dedicated to improving wallet user experience and Web3 onboarding for developers and end users alike. By sharing code openly and upholding a community-owned model, it seeks to foster better UX workflows, clearer onboarding paths, and broader participation in decentralized ecosystems. This approach centers openness over centralized control and invites ongoing collaboration across the Web3 community.

resources.tldr: Access, transparency and ownership are the stated values of web3, yet not every dapp behaves that way. A wallet team setting out its own obligations.
